title: A Rock and a Garden
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Look to the rock, Isaiah said,
The rock you came from, too;
Remember Sarah, Abraham,
Who walked this road for you.

[Chorus]
A rock to stand on, strong and sure,
A garden full of song;
He knows my grandma's name, and mine,
I'm His the whole day long.

[Verse 2]
He called to Abraham alone,
One man beneath the sky;
He blessed him, and his children grew
Like stars that fill the sky.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
The land was dry, the people sad,
Where nothing grew at all;
"I'll make your desert bloom," He said,
"Like Eden, green and tall."

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Wren found a picture in a box,
Great-grandma, long ago;
She carried it to show them all,
A rock she came to know.

[Chorus]
mood: Garden music. A slow, even sway under the voice, like a child turning the pages of an old family album in the afternoon sun. A small celtic harp picking out one steady pattern, a cello holding a long warm note underneath like a rock the tune can stand on. It starts dry and sparse, and a little more green comes in with every verse, until the last chorus is a garden with someone humming in it.
